field_evidence.dataset_statement: Details of every fire engine (pumping appliance) sent to an incident since January 2009.

records.evidence_slice: London Datastore publishes London Fire Brigade Mobilisation Records with details of every fire engine (pumping appliance) sent to incidents since January 2009. The current official resource 'LFB Mobilisation data 2025 onwards' covers January 2025 through July 2026, is updated monthly, is licensed under OGL v2, and the dataset's smallest geography is Coordinates. This batch binds verified Campden ward code E05009390 to that unused coordinate-level public-safety source window; the coordinate-to-ward subset and parcel join are deferred to local OpenCode, so no mobilisation row, geometry, or parcel progress is claimed.
